card.name: Linking words before antipsychotic examples
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'as', 'e.g.,' or 'of' right after 'dopamine antagonists' or antipsychotic dosing. They come just before a list of antipsychotic drugs like phenothiazines or haloperidol.

modes.label: Such as / e.g.
modes.description: The 'as' in 'such as' or the 'e.g.,' that introduces examples of dopamine antagonists.
modes.example: It is possible that dopamine antagonists, such<< as>> antipsychotics or metoclo

modes.label: Dose or patient link
modes.description: A small linking word right before an antipsychotic drug name in a dose or patient statement.
modes.example: operidol A study involving the administration of 6 to 10 mg/day<< of>> haloperidol to schizophrenic patients
